title: Terence McKenna's overdosing girlfriend sees an energy UFO full of mantids

tellings.quote: she sees up above and behind Terrence McKenna a huge uh UFO made of energy.

plain: While overdosing, the girlfriend of Terence McKenna, a writer famous for talking about psychedelic drugs, saw a huge UFO made of energy up above and behind him, full of beings shaped like praying mantises. Jason Jorjani, a researcher who studies Nazi UFO stories, retells this to Michels from McKenna's own account. He tells it as a hint that such beings may show up at the edge of death or altered states.
